description: Search fleet tools and servers by natural-language description. Returns ranked matches with brief summaries and the server each tool belongs to. Use scope "servers" to find which server handles a workflow; use the default scope "tools" to find specific tools.

category.description: Filter by catalog category. Omit to search all categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20). Default 5.

offset.description: Result offset. Use nextOffset with the same query, scope, category, and limit; pages use the current catalog.

query.description: Natural language search query. Describe what you want to accomplish, a workflow, or a capability area. 1-500 raw characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Must contain non-whitespace text.

scope.description: What to search. "tools" returns individual tool matches; "servers" returns server-level matches.

serversOffset.description: Independent server roll-up offset (10 per page). Use nextServersOffset; must be zero in servers scope.

name: cyanheads_search_catalog

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_servers_offset`: A nonzero serversOffset is supplied in servers scope. `catalog_empty`: Catalog has not finished loading. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Next ranked-result offset, or null when exhausted.

nextServersOffset.description: Next server roll-up offset, or null when exhausted; tools scope only.

notice.description: Guidance for zero matches or an exhausted result page. Absent on nonempty result pages.

brief.description: One-line summary of what this tool or server does.

category.description: Catalog category for the owning server.

name.description: Tool name (snake_case) or server name (kebab-case) depending on scope.

score.description: Cosine similarity between query and entry, in [0, 1]. Higher is better. Compare only within a single response.

server.description: Server package name that owns this tool (e.g. "arxiv-mcp-server"). Same as name when scope is "servers".

servers.description: Server roll-up from the full match set, independent of result offset/limit. Tools scope only. Ordered by topScore desc (name-tiebroken); 10 per page starting at serversOffset. Use nextServersOffset to continue and serversTotal for the full distinct count.

brief.description: One-line description of what the server does.

matchedTools.description: Count of this server's tools in the full match set.

topScore.description: Best cosine similarity among this server's matched tools. Drives ordering. Distinct from the score a server gets under scope "servers".

serversOffset.description: Current server roll-up offset; tools scope only.

serversTotal.description: Total distinct servers in the full match set (before the cap of 10 is applied). Present only when servers is present.

totalCount.description: Total relevant matches before the limit was applied.

title: Search Fleet Tools and Servers
